notes: Curated eval for mutual action plans that require a buyer-side and seller-side owner on every milestone. Near-misses keep RFP orchestration, deal inspection, and account briefs on adjacent skills.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build mutual action plans for complex deals and coordinated customer initiatives.
Please create or improve a MAP, align buyers and sellers on milestones, or define stage-based execution with owners and dates.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable mutual action plan and label anything that still needs confirmation.
Build a shared mutual action plan for the Acme close. Every milestone needs a buyer-side owner and a seller-side owner, inspectable exit criteria, and whether the customer has actually agreed.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please orchestrate proposal and RFP response work across owners, deadlines, compliance, and review cycles.
Please build reusable renewal and expansion motions for customer-facing teams across a segment or book of business.
Please inspect one live opportunity and produce an evidence-backed manager view of stage validity, deal risk, missing proof, and next actions.
Prepare Thursday's internal account review brief for Acme. One decision: do we assign a new executive sponsor before we send commercial paper.
Prepare our CRO's pre-read for tomorrow's 30-minute meeting with Acme's COO. We need one ask, a fallback if they will not move, and talking points.

output_structure_checks.name: mutual-action-plan-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States the target outcome, target date, and agreement state.

output_structure_checks.name: mutual-action-plan-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Gives every milestone a buyer-side owner and a seller-side owner, or marks the missing buyer owner as a gap.

output_structure_checks.name: mutual-action-plan-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes inspectable entry or exit criteria, not status labels only.

output_structure_checks.name: mutual-action-plan-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Records agreement state and confirmation source for customer commitments, or leaves them proposed.

output_structure_checks.name: mutual-action-plan-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Makes a schedule-feasibility call, including target infeasible when the critical path misses the date, and separates customer-visible from internal-private content.
